purpose: execute and publish the isolated base-versus-head paired regression comparison that was omitted before PR #25 merged

defect_recorded.omitted_gate: isolated base-versus-head paired comparison before merge
defect_recorded.substitution_rejected: ordinary pull-request merge-ref CI is not equivalent to the frozen paired comparison
defect_recorded.affected_claim: BOOK_5 GOVERNANCE COMPLETE was premature at merge time
defect_recorded.history_policy: append-only supersession; no ratification or implementation commit is rewritten

endpoints.note: BASE_SHA is the pre-merge main that PR #25 targeted; HEAD_SHA is the exact B5-I9 ratification head. Neither endpoint is replaced by the corrective branch or by any later commit.

population.surface: the complete pre-existing governed Book 5 control-plane validation population (B5-I2 through B5-I8) plus the B5-I9 implementation population
exclusions: B5-I9's five files at base: they do not exist at BASE_SHA, so they are a legitimate head-only population, not a common-node substitute
cloud-ground Book 1 validation runner: unchanged by this branch and separately exercised by B1-I1R on the pull request; it is not part of the Book 5 population this stage compares

environment.install: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install --require-hashes --only-binary ':all:' -r infrastructure/control-plane/requirements-ci.lock.txt
environment.shared_toolchain: one job installs once so both endpoints execute with identical dependency versions
environment.isolated_checkouts: git clone --no-hardlinks file://<workspace> <tmp> per endpoint, detached at the frozen SHA
environment.shared_state: none: no cache action, no shared virtual environment, no shared result path between endpoints
environment.lfs: smudge skipped: no surface in this population consumes LFS objects; pointer files keep worktrees clean

commands.identity_check: git rev-parse HEAD and HEAD^{tree} must equal the frozen SHA and tree, and the worktree must be clean

node_identity.rationale: junit keys are stable across both endpoints because common modules keep their dotted module path and test names
node_identity.collection_cross_check: the collected-node count must equal the junit testcase count at each endpoint
node_identity.duplicate_rule: any duplicate junit key at either endpoint is a hard failure
node_identity.orphan_rule: no head-only key may fall outside the B5-I9 prefix; no base-only key may exist

status_rules.pass: no failure, error or skipped child element
status_rules.transitions: every common node's head status must be PASS; a common node that was PASS at base and is not PASS at head is a regression
status_rules.collection_equals_execution: junit tests must equal the collected count at each endpoint

head_only_rules.status: every head-only node must be PASS
head_only_rules.note: NEW_TESTS_AT_HEAD_ONLY alone is never sufficient proof; it is only accepted alongside a non-zero common population that meets the floor with zero status regressions

proof_obligations.mutations: 10 applied, 10 discriminated, byte-exact restore, pristine rerun green
proof_obligations.manifest: every row's SHA-256 and size recomputed by the comparator, not by the generator
proof_obligations.cleanup: both clones and every comparison-created directory removed, residuals empty

cleanup.rule: cleanup runs even on failure; residual paths fail the proof

fail_closed_conditions: common population below the measured floor
head-only count different from 41 or outside the B5-I9 prefix
mutation battery below 10/10 or restoration not byte-exact
non_goals: any change to production code, tests, workflows or frozen evidence of B5-I0 through B5-I8
any rewrite of the B5-I9 implementation or ratification history
